title: bookkit volume manifest (manifest_version 1)
description: Contract for one volume's manifest.yaml. Paths are relative to the volume directory. The folder layout (front-matter, chapters, back-matter at the volume root) is a convention and is not validated.

manifest_version.description: Contract version of the manifest itself; only 1 exists.

profile.description: What kind of publication this manifest describes; only 'book' exists.

title.description: Required. Names the volume and, by the toolkit's slug rule, the PDF file.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle, passed through to the document.

isbn.description: Optional ISBN, passed to pandoc as the 'isbn' metadata variable so a consumer's own template can print it.

date.description: Optional date string, passed through to the document.

audience.description: Optional intended audience, passed as document metadata.

description.description: Optional description, passed as document metadata.

collection.description: Optional series name; in the single-volume shape the manifest may declare it, in the series shape series.yaml provides the default.

author.description: Optional override of the series.yaml author.

publisher.description: Optional override of the series.yaml publisher.

rights.description: Optional override of the series.yaml rights.

language.description: Optional override of the series.yaml language; the tool restricts it to the toolkit's supported codes (en, es, pt, gl).

chapter_start.description: Optional. The volume's first chapter prints with this number: the generated mode file sets the LaTeX chapter counter to chapter_start - 1.

chapters_dir.description: Folder used when 'chapters' is the keyword 'ordered'. Default: chapters.

toc_separators.description: Optional. Separates the contents into blocks at the two boundaries the adapter controls: none, space, rule or label. Default: space.

toc_labels.description: Optional. The words toc_separators: label prints, one per boundary. Required by that style.

anyOf.description: Keyword: the chapters are every *.md file in 'chapters_dir', in the toolkit's natural order.

chapters.description: Required, non-empty: either the keyword 'ordered' or an ordered list of entries (a path string, or a mapping with file/print/optional).

front_matter.description: Optional ordered map of logical name to entry; render order follows the manifest order.

back_matter.description: Optional ordered map of logical name to entry; render order follows the manifest order.
